title: Design System: Open Formal Workflows: Formal Conjectures Review, Verification & Preservation

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, active, and menu state transitions.

components.name: Active Tab
components.description: Current primary reviewer task with a restrained underline.
components.css: .ds-tab-active { font: 680 13px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 9px 11px 10px; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent); background: transparent; color: var(--ink0); } .ds-tab-active:hover { color: var(--accent); } .ds-tab-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Current Status Chip
components.description: Text plus color marker for evidence freshness.
components.css: .ds-state-current { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink0); font: 680 13px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-state-current span { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ok); }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Familiar queue search field with restrained focus.
components.html: <input class="ds-search" type="search" placeholder="Search #, title, author" aria-label="Search pull requests">
components.css: .ds-search { width: 230px; padding: 6px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--rule2); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--card); color: var(--ink0); font: 13px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search:hover { border-color: var(--ink2); } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Authority Boundary
components.description: Persistent but compact authority statement above every view.
components.html: Advisory workspaceFormal Conjectures is canonical for declarations, PR state, CI, and maintainer decisions.
components.css: .ds-boundary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 9px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--ink2); font: 12px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-boundary strong { color: var(--ink0); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .075em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Evidence Row
components.description: Claim, source with limitation, and typed outcome in reading order.
components.html: Comparator invocationPinned execution sourcenonzero_exit; exit code 1error
components.css: .ds-evidence-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 150px minmax(260px, 1fr) 126px; gap: 22px; padding: 13px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--ink1); font: 14px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-evidence-row strong { color: var(--ink0); } .ds-evidence-row small { display: block; color: var(--ink2); } .ds-evidence-row b { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: var(--bad); font-size: 12px; } .ds-evidence-row i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--bad); } .ds-evidence-row a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Review Summary
components.description: Four-row ledger separating evidence freshness, upstream PR state, advisory synthesis, and maintainer disposition.
components.css: .ds-review-summary { margin: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule2); } .ds-review-summary div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 112px 1fr; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-review-summary dt, .ds-review-summary small { color: var(--ink2); font-size: 11.5px; } .ds-review-summary dd { margin: 0; } .ds-review-summary strong, .ds-review-summary small { display: block; }

components.name: Progressive Disclosure
components.description: Native disclosure for replay pins, preservation mechanics, and method content.
components.html: Pinned inputs and replay environmentExact revisions and roots
components.css: .ds-disclosure { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule2); } .ds-disclosure summary { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 18px; padding: 16px 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-disclosure summary span { color: var(--ink2); font-size: 12px; }

narrative.overview: One exact pull request and its evidence packet on a clear desk. Identity, freshness, evidence, advisory conclusion, and maintainer disposition appear before replay internals or protocol.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Semantic color describes only the state named beside it and never implies acceptance.

rules.name: The Identity First Rule
rules.body: PRs, declarations, commits, roots, and paths remain readable text.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: Evidence rows, reports, and method steps use rules, not decorative shadow or glass.

dos: Do keep Formal Conjectures authority visible
Do answer five reviewer questions before technical detail
Do show exact source and environment identities close to claims
Do preserve error, unavailable, stale, and not-evaluated as distinct states
donts: Don't make method compete with the selected case
Don't resemble a generic AI-agent control plane
Don't collapse evidence into approval or merge readiness
Don't create a Vela-owned source of truth
Don't show fake partner or Econlib integration logos
